The vault keepers lost [Sairazul's](/Deities.aspx?ID=107) spark and have life spans of two to three millennia. They maintain and protect the xiomorns' many experiments. **[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 37 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 35 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 32 [Vault Keeper](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2629) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 108 **Perception** +26; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet **Languages** [Orvian](/Languages.aspx?ID=120), [Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109); [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=37) 300 feet **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +26, [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) +26, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +26, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +26, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +24, [Planar Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +28, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) +24 **Str** +4 **Dex** +8 **Con** +6 **Int** +8 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +6 **Craft Crystal Wand** ([exploration](/Traits.aspx?ID=66)) **Frequency** twice per day; **Effect** The vault keeper spends 10 minutes creating a magic wand out of radioactive green crystal, containing any 5th-rank or lower [earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55) spell of their choice. The wand can be used by other creatures, but it crumbles to sand at the end of the day and has no monetary value.
**Item Caster** The vault keeper can Cast a Spell from any item (such as a staff or wand) as though it were on their spell list. --- **AC** 36 **Fort** +24 **Ref** +28 **Will** +22 **HP** 200 **Immunities** bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [radiation](/Traits.aspx?ID=421), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145) **Resistances** physical 15 (except [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374)) **[Reactive Strike](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=48)** --- **Speed** 35 feet, climb 35 feet **Melee** claw +28 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)), **Damage** 3d10+10 slashing plus constraining crystal **Melee** crystal wand +28 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Radiation](/Traits.aspx?ID=421)), **Damage** 3d4+10 piercing plus 4d6 poison **Ranged** crystal shard +28 ([Earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range increment 100 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 5d6+6 piercing **Arcane Innate Spells** DC 34, attack +26 - **4th** [Earthbind](/Spells.aspx?ID=94) (at will), [Shape Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=276) (at will), [Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) (at will) - **5th** [Shatter](/Spells.aspx?ID=279) (at will), [Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) - **6th** [Scrying](/Spells.aspx?ID=268), [Stone Tell](/Spells.aspx?ID=310) (at will) - **7th** [Flesh to Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=123), [Summon Elemental](/Spells.aspx?ID=320) (earth only), [Wall of Stone](/Spells.aspx?ID=365) **Constraining Crystal** ([Earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)) When the vault keeper deals damage with a claw Strike, glowing green crystals cluster at the site of the attack. The target must succeed at a DC 31 Fortitude save or become [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) for 1 hour (or clumsy 2 on a critical failure). If the creature is already clumsy due to constraining crystal, additional failures increase that clumsy value instead, to a maximum of clumsy 4. **Crystal Burst** ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Earth](/Traits.aspx?ID=55)) An explosion of razor-sharp splinters deals 15d6 piercing damage in a 30-foot burst within 120 feet, with a DC 35 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. The vault keeper can't use Crystal Burst again for 1d4 rounds. **Slashing Surge** The vault keeper Strides or Climbs and makes two claw Strikes at any point during that movement. Each Strike must target a different creature. The multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.
